scientific.integrity: The phase classification is reduced to additive pair-sum relations and backed by a standalone exact-integer certificate; no numerical optimization is used for the theorem.
limitations: The classification is only for the explicit anisotropic spheres over the prime fields of orders 3 and 5.
The motivating 2026 preprint was compared through indexed metadata and abstract because the full PDF was unavailable through the accessible route.
No claim is made for larger finite fields.

title: Small-field phase dichotomy for anisotropic sphere extremizers
